statement: Fix l prime, E finite over Q_l, and a quasi-compact open immersion j:U→V on schemes where l is invertible. There exists a Context l E j [def-pur-completed-open-tensor-representative-data]. In particular, the two coefficient calculi use the canonical integral tensor models, their completion comparisons commute with actual adjunction units, and the all-input open reduction comparison restricts to completeOpen.r. The restriction/completion comparison has its actual-unit square. No ordinary tensor comparison gamma or representative tensor squares are asserted. Site and coefficient universes are independent.

proof.text: Choose coherent calculi together with ordinary and derived quotient/limit models on U and V using CompletionUnit.canonicalModels, whose site and coefficient universes are independent. Compare their closed integral tensors with IntegralOnSlice.duality through the common internal Hom, and replace the integralClosed fields by the canonical structures. Conjugate tensor, evaluation, currying and coherence comparisons by this natural isomorphism, leaving reduction and its adjunction fixed. This gives tensorV/U as equalities, not an inference of equality from a natural isomorphism.

proof.text: For these same coherent calculi use normalized open sections and openSemilinearTensorModel to obtain one Operations, TensorComparison, OrdinaryReduction pair and all-input Comparison. Quasi-compact extension preserves completeness by integralOpenExtensionComplete. Use the comparisonOfModel construction of IntegralOpenReductionComparison with this very same model, so completeOpen.r is the restriction of strictOpen.r. Its inverse-unit construction supplies completeOpen.d and the normalized realization equations; sameOpen is then the defining component identity.

proof.text: Transport the ordinary and derived quotient/limit models along the unchanged reduction data. Apply normalizedCompletionRealization on each scheme. Its comparison is pinned by the strict scalar-unit quotient/Roos augmentation and gives completionV/U together with exactly unitV/U. The global-section invertibility assumptions induce the required stalk and residue-field units. This uses the independent-universe API, not the same-universe scheme specialization of OpenQuotientKoszulCompleteness.

proof.text: Take the coefficient adic datum from the coefficient-only first conclusion of openQuotientKoszulCompleteness; it puts no restriction on the site universe. Its ideal is fixed to the uniformizer ideal by the stated equality, and all its other fields are propositions, so this datum is determined by that equality rather than an arbitrary witness. For the chosen Operations, OpenRoosRestriction.restrictionDescent gives restrictionCompletion and its actual-unit square. The ordinary adjunction unit for the subterminal open object is the invertible insertion/collapse pair. Exact localization gives the invertible derived openAdjunction.unit and hence openUnit and openUnitHom. These constructions use the same normalized operations, also for the empty and identity opens.
